summary: The tiny pale gabled checkpoint is recognizable, but the miniature is dominated by inaccurate dark fencing and one review view is unusable. Repair these presentation and characteristic-detail problems before approval.

orientation.summary: The sole actual door is on +v, outward SSE. On the north-up map this is the booth’s southern long side beside the open lane. Located SV2 views the -u gable from the west and also exposes that lane-facing +v side, supporting a single staff entrance there; the red STOP panels belong on the ±u gable ends. No duplicated principal portal appears in the inventory.

issues.problem: The extensive black chain-link fence overwhelms the booth and does not resemble the references’ pale, lightweight lattice/sliding gate assemblies.
issues.fix: Replace the dominant chain-link runs near the booth with simplified white or pale-gray open lattice gates and slimmer posts, preserving a clearly unobstructed vehicle lane.

issues.problem: The booth is too generic and visually weak compared with its prominent real-world cues.
issues.fix: Strengthen the pale siding, low gray gable with overhanging trim, end glazing, red STOP panels, and nearby flagpole while keeping the caricature simple.

issues.problem: The labeled +v face render is blocked by an extreme close-up lamp post, preventing visual inspection of the principal-door face.
issues.fix: Move the lamp or camera so the entire +v booth elevation and its single door are plainly visible.
